storySections.title: Basic Information
storySections.content:
Strictly speaking, she does not belong to this world on the brink of collapse, but she appreciates it.

She admires the magnificent spectacle of this world burning, appreciates the suffering and breakdown of these humans in despair.

Faith is dead, society has come to a halt, morals have crumbled, and nature no longer needs to disguise itself as a boring "normal person" —
she can finally unleash the beast within her and reveal her true self, becoming her authentic self.

storySections.title: Story: I
storySections.content:
On January 17, A.F.3, after receiving the notification of the review meeting regarding the human sacrifice held by the Sect of Astral Dawn in region @4, I immediately set out to investigate the area.

By the time I arrived, it was already evening, and the area was shrouded in thick fog for unknown reasons, making visibility nearly impossible.

I did not carry any devices to disperse the fog, but considering the seriousness of the situation, I rushed into the mist anyway. If time could rewind, I would never have made such a reckless move, because, because there were terrifying @2 in the fog...

When those indescribable, twisted beings attacked me at inhuman speed, I couldn't react at all. My body went rigid, unable to move.

But ultimately, I did not die. That girl, the enigmatic girl from the fog, saved me.

She may have shouted "Tornado"? I didn't catch it clearly; I only saw an axe flying out of the fog, cleaving the head of that terrifying creature. Then the girl took the axe and slung it over her shoulder.

"It's very dangerous in the fog; if you don't want to die, leave this place."

As she said this, her expression was smiling, a sweet smile of a young girl, but for some reason, I found that smile even more chilling than the monsters in the fog.

A human, or rather something with a human form, traversing through the mist filled with monsters, yet remaining unscathed while maintaining that "sweet" smile...

In fear, I finally got up and screamed, distancing myself from her.

Soon, the thick fog occupied my line of sight, and I fell into a state where I could see nothing again. But her laughter, her innocent, youthful laughter, kept echoing in the fog.

— "File: Investigation of the Sect of Astral Dawn in Region @4"

storySections.title: Story: II
storySections.content:
In the eyes of most students, Mouchette is definitely the most suitable person to be friends with. She always wears a smile, enthusiastically engages in conversations, and is unlikely to refuse any requests made to her, which is why she often gets invited to go shopping, chat, or eat.

But only a few know her true nature. In front of these people, she no longer has to pretend to be friendly or hide her contempt for rules and order.

"What friends? Just a way to pass the time out of boredom. If I don't do this, I'll be seen as a problem student and taken to see Principal Kellett for questioning—what a hassle."

storySections.title: Story: III
storySections.content:
Her life seemed to always be full of surprises: first, she encountered the rampant unknown fog, and then she was inexplicably summoned to another world.

When the summoning ritual was completed and she first set foot on the land of this other world, Mouchette saw the familiar thick fog, and within it, the screams of people.

Those were the sacrifices fleeing from the cultists.

Sacrifices? Cultists? What... exciting and fresh vocabulary.

This represented a new world, running a jungle game of survival of the fittest, and coincidentally, she had never been the weak one.

Calmly, she hunted the cultists in the fog, happily even humming a tune.

"One by one, and again... in the unknown fog, I vent freely ♪"

"Knock open your skull, delve into your brain, let's pass the time in this chase ♪"

Amidst this casual humming, Mouchette sensed the hollow hunger within her—
this mad world could not fill the void in her heart, but it could alleviate her soul's hunger for destruction and madness.

storySections.title: Story: IV
storySections.content:
One day, she will return to her own world.

But before that, she wants to see the conclusion of this world—

Will the one known as the "Keeper" be consumed by this chaotic and terrifying world, or will they shine brightly, bringing true redemption and light to this crumbling world?

This is a mystery, a challenge, a gamble.

And she wants to know the answer.

daily.title: Awakening
daily.content: Name's Mouchette, investigator of... Oh right, I'm not A.U.G.E.'s vanguard anymore. Let me reintroduce myself—I'm Mouchette, just a sweet, cute girl.

daily.title: Upgrade: I
daily.content: So you're still building me. Aren't you afraid I might lose control someday? Just kidding... Haha!

daily.title: Upgrade: II
daily.content: That's it... I'm getting closer to my "true self". I can feel it...

daily.title: Upgrade: III
daily.content: I'm still stuck here, but hey, getting stronger is always nice.

daily.title: Enlighten: Observe
daily.content: This ritual sends me home? You sure? How many times have we tried...? Well, trying never hurts, I guess.

daily.title: Enlighten: Ponder
daily.content: It feels like I'm stepping into the Mist again. Speaking of which, I already miss those little creatures in the Mist. Too bad I can't vent my bad mood on them anymore.

daily.title: Enlighten: Reflect
daily.content: Is the ritual not over yet? I really wanna go back. Been craving some Ravenlog Stewed Fish and steaming Hazelnut Kava Tea lately. Though, the Ceylon Black Tea and Andalusian Churros here aren't bad either.

daily.title: Enlighten: Insight
daily.content: Keeper, I think I saw a light... Did it work this time...? I wonder how my colleagues are doing? They'd better not leave a mountain of work for me; I will not work overtime.

daily.title: Enlighten: Elevate
daily.content: Ah... So it didn't work. I expected as much. Life is full of ups and downs—well, mostly downs... you get used to it one day. Still, thanks for trying.

daily.title: Enlighten: Florish
daily.content: You know, it doesn't seem so bad to stay here for a while. I'll remember everything that happens here, write it down, and share it with them back home. How about the title <Italic:Mouchette's Otherworld Adventure>? It has a nice ring to it, right?

daily.title: Affinity: I
daily.content: You want a deep conversation for my mental health? C'mon, spare me. If we must bore ourselves, let's at least be quick about it.

daily.title: Affinity: II
daily.content: I'm just pretending to be normal when answering your questions, you say? Heh, you caught me. So, are you ready to see what I really am?

daily.title: Affinity: III
daily.content: An uncontrollable maniac? Bingo! This is not my world; no tedious laws or rules can hold me back... Here, I do whatever I want. So be careful, Keeper, you never know when a maniac might bite.

daily.title: Affinity: IV
daily.content: So my true self doesn't scare you because you've "seen true terror"? Hmph... a cunning reply. But that just makes me... want to pick you apart even more.

daily.title: Affinity: V
daily.content: What's the world like in your eyes? Where are the limits of true terror? Don't just tell me; I wanna go feel it first hand with you, feel all the madness, death, and horror! Yeah, I've made up my mind! I'm not leaving your side until my curiosity is satisfied!

daily.title: Chat: Touch
daily.content: New mission? Skip the pleasantries next time; we're way past needing to perform the "socialization rituals" by now.

daily.title: Chat: About the Crisis
daily.content: I know as much about Dissolution as I do about the Mist Disaster back home—nothing, that is. But that's precisely what makes them so fascinating, right?

daily.title: Chat: About Mythag
daily.content: We're too close to human settlements here; boring adults are everywhere... Have you ever considered moving the school to the deserted deep mountains?

daily.title: Chat: What I Like
daily.content: I'm starting to love this feeling of being stranded in another world! Strong Awakeners, terrifying Dissolution, and mysterious gods! Ah, the sheer exhilaration of being far away from the mundane!

daily.title: Chat: What I Hate
daily.content: Hate? I wouldn't say that. I merely wish those tedious meetings, social obligations, and universal values could one day poof! Be gone.

daily.title: Chat: About the Keeper
daily.content: You want to save this twisted, terrifying world? That's gonna be a crazy fun way to die. Let's see how far you can go.

daily.title: Chat: About Karen
daily.content: A maid? I've been one too. I should find time to show her my vacuum cleaner moves in battle!

daily.title: Chat: About Murphy
daily.content: I admit she's quite cute... Yeah, she's adorable when chasing and fighting those campus strays.

daily.title: Chat: About Salvador
daily.content: Sacrificing yourself for other people? What a stupid idea. It's infuriating. No one has the right to ask that of anyone, not even a god.

battle.title: Investigation Begins
battle.content: Wanna taste my axe, sweeties? Don't fret, here it comes...

battle.title: Investigation Successful
battle.content: That's all? I was just starting to have fun! Come on, who's next for the chop?

battle.title: Investigation Halted
battle.content: They say one failure doesn't define you... I disagree! My axe's gonna do the defining, so keep your necks on a swivel!

battle.title: Special Skill: I
battle.content: Line up nicely for my axe!

battle.title: Rouse
battle.content: Finally, no more pretending... Now, let's have some <Italic:real> fun.

battle.title: Over-Exalt
battle.content: Haha, now this is the life! Beats the boring daily grind any day!
